name: AI, Embedded, and Data Specialisation Artifact Completeness
description: A trained model is documented and evaluated, a firmware build is verified against its declared hardware interface, and a data pipeline's output meets its own declared quality thresholds.

conditions.statement: A Model Card exists for every trained model, declaring its own Training Data Specification and Model Evaluation Report.
A Firmware Build is accompanied by a Hardware Compatibility Report confirming it against its declared Hardware Interface Specification.
A Data Pipeline Specification's own output meets the thresholds declared in its Data Quality Report before being consumed downstream.
